title: D3: Planner as a function — the daemon invokes a fresh headless Planner only at decision points (scouts done, task held, goal closable)
spec:
Why: the interactive Planner spent about 11.2M tokens on 2026-09-18, most of it re-sending a 250k context on 112 wait notifications. Build on C-O3 v3 (orchestrator/goals.py launches a headless Planner) and C-O7b (handover writes the checkpoint). Implement orchestrator/planner_runs.py: decision_points(root) scans the bus for goals (parentless triage tasks not done) and yields (goal_id, kind, payload) for: "scouts_done" when the goal has scout children, all are done or failed, no execute child exists yet and no planner run is recorded for this kind on this goal; "held" for each execute child with status held and no planner run recorded for (goal, task, hold_reason); "closable" when every execute child is merged, no queued or running children remain, and no run of kind closable exists. run(root, goal_id, kind, payload): if a Planner pid for this root is alive (goals.py identity), skip; else handover.write(f"decision {kind}"), then launch exactly like goals.start's launch step but with prompt rendered from .orchestrator/prompts/planner-decision.md ({{kind}}, {{goal_id}}, {{payload}}: "Read .orchestrator/plan.md and the bus. Decision: <kind>. Do only what this decision needs, write plan.md, and finish."), --max-budget-usd from limits.max_budget_usd.get("planner_decision", 3), record {goal_id, kind, payload_key, pid, started_at, log} in .orchestrator/runs/planner_runs.json under the bus lock. daemon.tick(): after the stages, when pool.cfg.get("planner", {}).get("autonomous", False) is true, iterate decision_points and run each (one launch per tick at most). pool.toml: [planner] autonomous = false (the interactive session stays the default until the human flips it) with a comment. Tests in tests/test_planner_runs.py with fixtures from the harness and subprocess.Popen patched: scouts_done_detected_once, held_detected_per_hold_reason, closable_detected, run_skips_when_planner_alive, tick_launches_at_most_one_and_only_when_autonomous. README.md: "Autonomous mode" paragraph.
(Recreated from T-0112: re-pointed at C-O3 v4 and the recreated C-O7b)
acceptance: tests/test_planner_runs.py has the five named tests, green
With [planner] autonomous = false (committed default) tick() launches nothing and existing daemon tests are unchanged and green
planner_runs.json records one entry per (goal, kind, payload) and a second tick does not relaunch the same decision
`uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests` green; no new dependency

result.summary: superseded by D3 v2 (next id after T-0186): spec review T-0182 requested changes (handover.py missing on the branch, now fixed by the D0 rebase T-0185; interactive Planner not detected so autonomous mode could launch a competing Planner; root parameter the bus cannot honour; no account/budget check before launch; goals.start launch step not shared). Specs are immutable, so recreated.

spec_review_risks.issue: orchestrator/handover.py does not exist anywhere in this task's branch (task/T-0182, merge-base with main is 2ae174e). handover.py only landed via T-0119 on goal/T-0073, which has not been merged into goal/T-0109 or this task's base. The spec requires `handover.write(f"decision {kind}")` in planner_runs.run(); as written this is an ImportError the moment planner_runs.py is imported, failing every acceptance criterion including 'existing daemon tests unchanged and green'.

The 'Planner alive' skip-check reuses goals.py's identity()/_running_goal(), which only recognize pids recorded in .orchestrator/runs/goals.json — written exclusively by goals.start(). An interactive/foreground Planner session (exactly the kind that produced the 11.2M-token day this feature targets) is never recorded there, so with [planner] autonomous=true the daemon can launch a second, competing decision Planner into the same repo/worktree while a human-driven session is mid-task, racing commits, plan.md edits and bus writes.

decision_points(root)/run(root, ...) take a root argument that bus.py cannot honor: ROOT/STATE are bound once per-process from ORCH_ROOT (orchestrator/__init__.py), and bus.read()/bus.locked() always act on that single STATE regardless of any root passed in. The spec apes goals.py's repo-generic signature without stating that root must equal ROOT, leaving room for an implementation that assumes real multi-root scanning.

run() launches a `claude -p` subprocess with no account parameter and no described check of account cooldown, daily_budget_tokens, or reserve_for_planner before Popen — unlike goals.start() (validates account_id/budget) and dispatch()/free_slots() elsewhere in daemon.py. Under autonomous mode with several goals hitting decision points in one tick, this can fire against an already-cooling or over-budget account.

goals.start()'s launch step (env/argv/Popen, including _filter_target_secrets guarding untrusted target pool.toml secrets) is inline in one function with no reusable helper. 'launch exactly like goals.start's launch step' forces planner_runs.py (goals.py itself is out of Scope) to duplicate that block rather than call a shared function, risking a future edit silently dropping the secrets-filter guard from one copy.
